defaults.rationale: Declared numerical/model validation setting; not an identified Cai publication or branded vehicle parameter.

parameters.name: low_speed_relaxation_s
parameters.rationale: Relax lateral velocity and yaw rate to kinematic targets below the dynamic model blend speed.

parameters.name: actuator_jerk_limit_mps3
parameters.rationale: Development actuator jerk bound equal to the previously registered comfort value; no emergency policy implemented.

parameters.name: steering_lateral_envelope_mps2
parameters.rationale: Speed-dependent target steering envelope; tire force saturation independently enforces friction circle. Transient actual lateral acceleration is measured separately.

parameters.name: linear_tire_slip_limit_rad
parameters.rationale: Operational small-slip validity warning threshold; not a tire calibration.

parameters.name: max_dynamics_dt_s
parameters.rationale: Reject excessively coarse RK4 calls; tested actual dt values are0.01/0.005.

parameters.name: tracking_kp_per_s2
parameters.rationale: Single-vehicle bench lateral tracking gain; not a NOA decision rule.

parameters.name: maneuver_duration_s
parameters.rationale: Bench quintic reference duration only; may equal paper structure period numerically but does not redefine that period as an integration/control step.

parameters.name: sweep_max_depth
parameters.rationale: Adaptive conservative swept-body check: unresolved leaf means potential collision/outside, never declared safe.

parameters.name: sumo_speed_mode
parameters.rationale: External control bench; SUMO speed safety disabled, own continuous geometry audit remains required.

parameters.name: sumo_lane_change_mode
parameters.rationale: Disable native autonomous lane changes; all lateral movement is integrated.

parameters.name: sumo_move_keep_route
parameters.rationale: Keep original route and exact XY instead of lane-center snapping; off-road faults are checked independently.
